description: Single-file Breakout/Arkanoid: mouse and keyboard paddle, multi-hit and unbreakable bricks, power-ups (multi-ball, wide paddle, laser, slow ball), particles, lives, score, 4+ levels with brick layouts, pause and level transition.

criteria: breakout_model_01.html is one self-contained Breakout (no libraries): a paddle controlled by both mouse and keyboard, ball with correct wall/paddle reflections where paddle position changes the angle, brick layouts for at least 4 levels with multi-hit colored bricks and unbreakable ones, falling power-ups that actually work (multi-ball, wider paddle, laser shots, slow ball, extra life), lives, score with per-brick values, particles on hits, level transitions, pause, and a win/lose screen. No fake collisions.
